==Polish==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|pl|:inh|zlw-opl:aż|tree=+|text=+}}

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-#.ogg;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-#.wav|hh=-arz,-aż|mp=#|krk=#|CGP=#|ost=#}}

===Conjunction===
{{head|pl|conjunction}}

# [[until]]
#: {{syn|pl|[[póki|póki nie]], [[dopóki|dopóki nie]]}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Dokuczał mi, '''aż''' zacząłem płakać.|He bullied me '''until''' I started crying.}}
# {{lb|pl|obsolete}} [[voila]]; [[soon]], [[shortly]]; [[suddenly]]
# {{lb|pl|Middle Polish}} [[only]]; [[scarcely]]; [[as soon as]]; [[when]], [[as]]

====Usage notes====
Combined forms for this word are uncommon and often formed for stylization.

====Declension====
{{pl-decl-combined-forms-e}}

==Silesian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|szl|aże}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|szl|:inh|zlw-opl:aż|tree=+|text=+}}

===Pronunciation===
{{szl-pr|a=LL-Q30319 (szl)-Vxern-#.wav}}

===Particle===
{{head|szl|particle}}

# {{ng|emphasizes the quantity}}; [[so many|as many as]]
#: {{ux|szl|'''Aż''' siedym chałup bez miesiōnc hań postawiyli.|They put up ''seven'' houses during the month here.}}
# {{ng|emphasizes the amount}}; [[so much|as much as]]
#: {{ux|szl|Straciōł ech '''aż''' tysiōnc litrōw miodu skuli tych pierōńskich chrobŏkōw.|I lost ''a thousand'' litres of honey because of these bloody bugs.}}
# {{ng|emphasizes the scale of a quality}}; [[so]], [[almost]]; [[even]], [[actually]]
#: {{ux|szl|Ôbejzdrzij sie na niego, ôn je '''aż''' bioły ze strachu.|Look at him, he's so scared he '''even''' turned white.}}
# {{ng|emphasizes the length of time}}; [[all the way]]
#: {{ux|szl|Tōż trzeba bōło '''aż''' do połednia czekać.|So we had to wait '''all the way up''' 'til noon.}}
# {{ng|emphasizes the distance}}; [[all the way]]
#: {{uxi|szl|Mōm '''aż''' tam zōńś?!|I have to go '''all the way''' up there?!}}
# {{lb|szl|emphatic}} {{ng|used for exaggeration}}; [[basically]], [[essentially]], [[practically]]
#: {{ux|szl|Tak sie zeszterowoł, że '''aż''' mu ôgyń z pyska lecioł.|He got so furious that you could say he was '''practically''' breathing fire.}}

===Conjunction===
{{head|szl|conjunction}}

# {{ng|emphasizes the extent or degree}}; [[so much so]] [[that]], [[to the point]] [[that]]
#: {{ux|szl|Tak sie tyn synek wyuczōł, '''aż''' ôstoł farŏrzym.|This chap learnt '''so much that''' he became a local pastor.}}
#: {{ux|szl|Babie bōło głupio, '''aż''' sie borŏka cołkŏ czerwiōnŏ zrobiyła.|The lady was so embarrassed '''that''' she went all red.}}
# {{ng|sets a precondition}}; [[until]]
#: {{ux|szl|Nic ci niy dōm, '''aż''' mie szyciŏ niy nauczysz!|I won't give you ought '''until''' you teach me how to sew!}}
